application.name: Point Cloud to Depth
application.description: Projects PointCloud messages into the pinhole camera a CameraInfo describes, on the GPU, with holoscan-point-cloud's PointCloudToDepthOp, the camera from a ROS camera_info file through holoscan-messages' CameraInfoSourceOp, making z-buffered depth images (float32 meters or uint16) and color images, from synthetic clouds checked pixel by pixel against ground truth, or from a folder of PLY files, and can write the images as PGM and PPM files.

changelog.2.0.0: holoscan-point-cloud 2.0: the clouds are PointCloud messages, and the camera comes from a camera_info file through CameraInfoSourceOp (written at run time for the synthetic camera, --camera-info for PLY files, whose size the images take) or with every synthetic cloud; --width and --height for files, --fx, --fy, --cx, --cy and --intrinsics-input are gone.
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-point-cloud demo of PointCloudToDepthOp, with synthetic and PLY point cloud sources, a ground-truth reporter and PGM and PPM output.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Project 300 synthetic point clouds with colors, checking every depth and color pixel against ground truth.

files.description: Project the binary little-endian PLY files in the data directory into the camera of the camera_info.yaml file next to them. Pass the extrinsics with --run-args if the points are not in the camera's optical frame.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic clouds in a body frame with colors and the camera from a camera_info file, projected to uint16 depth, every pixel checked against ground truth.
